Company Description

About us

Solflare is one of the fastest-growing crypto wallets in the world. With around 4 million monthly active users and over $20 billion in digital assets secured through our platform, we’re building a powerful gateway to Web3. Founded in 2021, Solflare now has a team of nearly 150 people, with offices in Zagreb, Belgrade, and Novi Sad, plus remote teams across the globe. Our vision is simple but bold: a world where everyone uses a Web3 wallet and has full control over their assets – achieving true financial independence.

Our culture

At Solflare, we’re on a mission to empower people to truly own and thrive – starting with our own team. We take on bold challenges with curiosity, grit, and a deep sense of accountability. Here, progress means learning fast, solving smart, and showing up for each other without ego. You’ll join a team where we question the status quo, celebrate shared wins, and never settle for “just good enough.” If you’re excited by growth – yours, ours, and society’s – you’ll feel right at home.

Job Description

The role

This is not a testing role in the traditional sense. We're not looking for someone to catch bugs at the end of the pipeline and hand them back. We're looking for someone to own how quality happens across the entire product. As we like to put it: QA owns the testing strategy, not product quality. Product quality is shared by Product and Engineering.

Your job is to make sure the whole system is set up so that everyone can build confidence in what we ship, from the moment a feature is designed to the moment it's released. That means enabling engineers to test effectively, driving a quality mindset across teams, and building the systems and processes that support it, not just writing and running test cases.

We think about quality the way our users experience the product: as complete journeys, not as a checklist of acceptance criteria. If you read this and think "quality is someone else's problem once I've logged the bug," this role isn't for you. If you think in terms of "can the user actually achieve their goal here, and how do I make the whole team confident that they can," keep reading.

This is a senior role because it demands ownership. Not the word, the behavior: seeing what needs to happen and making it happen without being told, working across Product, Engineering, Data as a matter of course, and taking responsibility for the testing strategy of a feature end to end.

Core responsibilities

  • Own the testing strategy for the features and areas you work on. Decide how confidence gets built, which validation happens at which layer (unit, component, integration, API, golden, E2E, accessibility, performance, security, manual, exploratory), rather than defaulting everything to end-to-end testing.
  • Get involved early. Join discovery and specification reviews before development starts: clarify assumptions, surface edge cases, identify risks and dependencies, and ask the hard questions ("what happens if the API fails, if permissions are denied, if the user abandons the flow?").
  • Design test cases as part of feature development, not after it. Covering user journeys, happy paths, edge cases, error handling, recovery, and regression.
  • Enable engineers to own their part of quality. Give developers the test suites, regression packs, environments, and mock data they need to validate their own work before it reaches you, and help build a culture where they do.
  • Do the testing that matters. Structured execution of prepared cases plus mandatory exploratory testing to find what predefined cases can't predict, like usability issues, cross-feature interactions, and wrong assumptions.
  • Maintain a living view of test coverage per feature. So release decisions are based on measurable confidence rather than "the ticket is closed."
  • Continuously improve the automation strategy and the process itself. Reduce flakiness, close coverage gaps, cut repetitive manual regression, and free up time for exploratory, accessibility, security, and performance work.
  • Bring AI/LLM tools into the workflow. Use them to speed up test case design, automation scripting, and exploratory testing, and keep pushing the team's QA practices forward as new tools emerge.

 

 

Qualifications

Requirements: 

  • A minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Senior level experience in QA. You've owned quality for real features or products, made your own calls on testing strategy, and been accountable for the outcome, not just executed test plans someone else wrote.
  • A genuine ownership and proactivity mindset. You spot gaps and close them, you drive things rather than wait to be assigned, and you don't treat quality as "done" the moment a bug is filed.
  • A user- and product-first way of thinking. You test journeys and business outcomes, not just acceptance criteria, and you keep the user at the center of every decision about what and how to test.
  • Security mindset.
  • Comfort with the "shift-left" idea: quality is built throughout development, not verified at the end.
  • Hands-on experience with automation tools such as WebdriverIO, Patrol, Selenium, Cypress, Appium, or Playwright.
  • Experience writing backend tests (API, unit, database) and testing RESTful services with tools such as Postman or similar
  • Experience with CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
  • We prioritise strong automation skills, but if your background is mostly manual, a proactive attitude, a solid technical base, and a real drive to pick up automation quickly - will still get our attention.

Nice to have: 

  • Experience in web3 or fintech, or anywhere you've tested products that handle real money. When money is on the line, there's no room for "probably fine," so it sharpens your attention to detail and your instinct for edge cases in a way that carries over well here.
  • Experience with testing across multiple layers (API, integration, golden/screenshot, performance, accessibility).
  • Experience with security testing

Additional Information

Personality Traits We Value

  • Problem-solvers: You see roadblocks as opportunities and don’t wait around for someone else to fix things.
  • Self-starters: You take initiative, follow through, and deliver with pride – no excuses, no shortcuts.
  • Team players: You thrive in a “we, not me” culture, lifting others up while sharing the load.
  • Adaptable minds: You embrace change, question how things are done, and constantly look for better ways.
  • Ownership mindset: You own your work end-to-end, communicate openly, and learn from every challenge.

Why Solflare?

  • Make an impact: Your work will directly shape how people interact with and understand crypto wallets, empowering users around the globe.
  • Work with the best: Collaborate with a talented, driven team across design, engineering, and product to build innovative, user-first experiences.
  • Flexibility: Remote or office – up to you. Enjoy a flexible work environment based on trust that supports your well-being and fosters creativity, as well as flexible work time – work when you are most productive, with no micromanagement.
  • Perks & benefits: individual education budget, cool team buildings, private health insurance, to name a few.
  • Learn about Crypto: No crypto experience? No problem! You’ll be part of a team that will teach you the ropes and help you grow into an expert.

Join us at Solflare and be part of something bigger than yourself. We’re not just reacting to trends; we’re building the future. If you’re ready to push boundaries, challenge assumptions, and make an impact, we want to hear from you.

Apply now and help us shape the future of decentralized finance.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the Team

The Account Management team at Bridge is dedicated to the growth, retention, and expansion of key customers. Our Scaled Account Management team focuses on driving measurable expansion across a broad portfolio of mid-market and high-growth customers through data-driven strategies, efficient processes, and strong cross-functional partnership.

What You'll Do

As a Scaled Account Manager at Bridge you will own a book of existing accounts and be responsible for expanding revenue, identifying product gaps and driving product adoption, preventing churn and ensuring renewals at scale. You will combine consultative selling with volume playbooks, prioritization based on quantitative signals, and hands-on execution to identify and close upsell opportunities across your territory. As Bridge continues to develop within Stripe’s Money Management organization, you will also drive your customers’ adoption of additional features available through Stripe. 

Responsibilities

  • Own a book of existing accounts and drive revenue growth through additional usage, upsells, cross-sells, and renewals.
  • Develop and execute scalable go-to-market strategies that increase revenue per account and accelerate product adoption across your portfolio.
  • Use data and quantitative analysis to prioritize accounts and identify the highest-impact expansion opportunities.
  • Generate leads through targeted outreach, research, and campaign execution; manage high-velocity deal cycles from qualification to close.
  • Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders to understand business priorities, surface pain points, and tailor Bridge solutions.
  • Lead commercial negotiations and renewals to expand and retain customer revenue.
  • Identify churn signals in your book and implement strategies to prevent revenue losses.
  • Coordinate with product, success, risk, and operations teams to solve complex customer needs and ensure a great user experience.
  • Translate customer feedback into actionable product and process improvements to better serve scaled customer segments.

Who You Are

-5–8 years of full sales cycle or account management experience focused on existing business accounts; experience managing a large book of accounts or high-velocity portfolio strongly preferred.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience using data to prioritize accounts, build business cases, and track outcomes.
  • Comfortable understanding technical product requirements and articulating solutions across multiple technology products.
  • Demonstrated ability to close upsell opportunities and manage complex pricing or commercial negotiations.
  • Excellent operational acumen and proven ability to manage time and prioritize across a high-volume territory.
  • Highly motivated, persistent, and effective in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
  • Superior written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness and ability to work in-office in New York or San Francisco at least three days per week.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience at a high-growth payments, fintech, crypto, or technology company.
  • Experience with CRM tools, Excel, and basic SQL or a demonstrated comfort with data tools and analysis.
  • Background in working cross-functionally with product, risk, and operations teams to deliver outcomes for customers.

Why Bridge

Join a team that values clear thinking, quantitative rigor, and customer obsession. At Bridge you’ll own meaningful customer outcomes, operate with autonomy, and have the opportunity to shape how we scale revenue across high-potential accounts.
descriptions.job-0csfvdv:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM's Finance team keeps revenue and billing accurate, automated, and audit-ready as the company scales. As our Revenue and Billing Operations Manager, you will own the billing function and be a key contributor to revenue accounting, building scalable processes, replacing manual work with automation, and ensuring our records and controls are always audit-ready. You’ll have the opportunity to shape the function from a lean base—deciding what to automate, building the right controls, and creating processes that can scale with TRM.

The Impact You Will Have:

  • Automate manual billing work, reconciliations, invoice generation, exception flagging, and data validation, building AI-assisted workflows and owning the review and controls that ensure accuracy and audit readiness.

  • Strengthen revenue accounting so our records are accurate and consistently audit-ready, using AI to accelerate reconciliations and documentation while you verify what touches the books.

  • Evaluate and implement billing solutions that fit how TRM works, using AI to compare options, assess tradeoffs, and model impact.

  • Build a prioritized automation roadmap: decide what to automate first and next, and measure the time it gives back to the team.

  • Build scalable, resilient billing processes that keep pace with growth and reduce key-person dependency.

  • Partner with Sales, Legal, and Accounting to evaluate how contracts and policies are structured and their downstream billing impact.

What We're Looking For:

  • Demonstrated AI fluency: you can identify which finance processes to automate, build the workflows, and articulate where AI output must be verified before it is trusted.

  • Senior experience across revenue accounting and billing operations.

  • Hands-on experience leading the evaluation and implementation of billing solutions and automating billing or finance processes.

  • Experience leading external audits and building and maintaining audit-ready processes and controls.

  • Strategic judgment on automation sequencing and designing effective, scalable controls.

  • A hands-on, builder mindset: you’re comfortable operating in the details, solving problems directly, and doing the work yourself as part of a lean team.

  • Clear cross-functional communication with Sales, Legal, and Accounting.

About the Team:

  • Finance is lean and fast-moving; this role adds senior capacity and redundancy to revenue and billing.

  • You will have real ownership and the mandate to modernize the function, not just maintain it.

  • The work is demanding: doing more with less, ahead of a first-year audit, on a team that moves fast.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • The team is distributed, not distant, with strong async communication and US working-hours overlap.

  • Close collaboration with Sales/Deal Desk, Accounting, and Legal.

Learn About TRM Speed:

  • Within the first 90 days, automate at least one high-volume manual billing process end to end with documented controls.

  • In the first 30 days, map the full revenue and billing process and identify the top automation opportunities.

  • Within the first two quarters, deliver an audit-ready improvement to revenue accounting ahead of the first-year audit.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.

What to Expect From Our Interview Process

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Typically 3–5 interviews to go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.

  • Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.

  • Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

Learn more about interviewing at TRM

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate

  • Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more about Interviewing at TRM

 

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. Learn more about building tools for defenders.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

descriptions.job-149l1pf:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

Who We Are

Most Executive Operations functions move information. ExecOps at Block is built to generate it. We sit at the intersection of every major initiative — seeing what no individual executive can see simultaneously. We don't just move information to leaders; we route what we observe back into the system: naming what's stuck, surfacing misalignment, correcting drift before it calcifies. A centralized function compounds that intelligence — patterns that span organizations, signals that surface before they become problems. This is not simply a coordination function. It is an intelligence function.

Job Description

At Block, the Executive Operations team amplifies the impact of executives and their teams by keeping priorities clear, decisions moving, and information flowing across the organization. We are looking for a highly trusted, strategic Executive Business Partner  that carries responsibility beyond a single executive partnership. 

In this role, you will operate as a strategic partner, helping shape operating rhythms, manage complex priorities, improve workflows, and create leverage across teams. You will combine exceptional administrative execution with strong business judgment, proactive problem-solving, stakeholder influence, and the ability to build scalable systems that improve executive and team effectiveness.

At a principal level, this role architects scalable support models, designs repeatable frameworks used across ExecOps, mentors other members of the function, and leads improvements that strengthen how ExecOps supports leaders across business unit

Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic and administrative partnership for 1–2 senior executives, balancing day-to-day operational excellence with long-term executive effectiveness.
  • Proactively manage complex calendars, travel, expenses, meeting cadence, and executive workflows with strong judgment, discretion, and attention to shifting business priorities.
  • Design and maintain executive operating rhythms, including leadership meetings, staff meetings, business reviews, planning cycles, all-hands, offsites, and follow-up mechanisms.
  • Drive adoption of AI, automation, and workflow tools to increase executive leverage, reduce manual work, improve information flow, and create scalable practices for the executive and broader team.
  • Ensure executives are prepared and effective by synthesizing context, managing information flow, identifying decision points, tracking follow-through, and surfacing risks or gaps.
  • Build strong relationships across cross-functional partners, and the Executive Operations team to improve alignment, communication, and execution.
  • Anticipate needs, resolve ambiguity, and independently drive solutions in fast-moving, sensitive, or high-stakes situations.
  • Identify and improve systems, workflows, and processes that create leverage for executives and their teams, including reporting, goal tracking, meeting hygiene, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
  • Own or support high-impact executive programs, team moments, offsites, planning processes, and cross-functional initiatives from planning through execution and follow-up.
  • Capture and scale institutional knowledge by creating clear documentation, templates, playbooks, or repeatable practices that improve continuity and decision-making.
  • Contribute to the centralized Executive Operations team by sharing best practices, mentoring peers, and helping raise the bar for executive support across Block.
  • For Principal-level candidates: architect scalable support models, lead cross-functional process improvements, and coach others on executive partnership, stakeholder management, and strategic operating systems.

Qualifications

  • 8–12+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Business Partner, Administrative Business Partner, Chief of Staff partner, or similar role supporting senior executives; experience in fast-moving technology or product-led companies preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a trusted strategic partner to senior leaders, with strong judgment, discretion, and ability to manage sensitive information.
  • Exceptional calendar, workflow, travel, and executive operations management skills, including the ability to prioritize across competing demands and shifting business needs.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to connect day-to-day executive support to broader team, product, and company priorities.
  • Proven experience designing or improving operating rhythms, executive workflows, planning processes, meeting systems, documentation, or cross-functional coordination mechanisms.
  • Excellent relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions, levels, and working styles.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex context, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate with clarity and sound judgment.
  • High emotional intelligence, composure, and ability to navigate ambiguity, organizational dynamics, and high-pressure situations.
  • Advanced proficiency with Google Workspace, including Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms, and related collaboration tools.
  • Comfort using data, AI, automation, or workflow tools to improve executive effectiveness, reduce manual work, and scale repeatable processes.
  •  As a principal level candidate, demonstrated experience mentoring other executive support professionals, creating scalable frameworks, leading function-wide improvements, or influencing support strategy across teams or business units.

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting C-Suite 
  • Experience supporting executives in hybrid or distributed teams.
  • Experience planning leadership offsites, all-hands, business reviews, or annual/quarterly planning processes.
  • Experience building templates, playbooks, dashboards, or systems that improve team operations at scale.

Job Title: Technical Client Success Manager

Reports to: Global Head of Client Delivery

Location: Hong Kong (Remote Worker)

About Elwood

Elwood Technologies is an FCA regulated firm that provides end-to-end institutional-grade digital asset Execution, Liquidity Access and Portfolio Monitoring & Risk Management Software. Built with institutions for institutions, Elwood’s offers best available price execution, smart order routing and algorithmic tooling alongside a traditional finance grade Portfolio Management System.

Built by industry experts with decades of combined experience in investment management and digital technology, we are looking for a Technical Client Success Manager to join our Client Delivery team and own client relationships across our global client base.

The Role

Elwood is seeking a Technical Client Success Manager to join our Client Delivery team. With team members based in London, New York, and Singapore, the team delivers follow-the-sun, world-class service to clients operating in the digital asset ecosystem.

This role combines client ownership with hands-on technical support. You will own a defined book of clients end-to-end — their health, adoption, and growth — acting as their trusted advisor and their voice inside Elwood , while actively partnering with Sales to pitch to prospective institutional clients. You will understand client expectations, solutionise complex workflow needs into concrete platform configurations and engineering requirements, drive account growth, and carry the technical depth to support your clients directly, participating in the APAC support rota as part of our global coverage model.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who possesses a deep technical foundation of front to back trading systems and strong commercial instincts and presentation skills who is excited about digital assets and the technologies powering next-generation financial systems.

Responsibilities

  1. Client Relationship Management & Expectation Setting
  • Own a defined book of clients and act as the accountable owner of each client’s success throughout their lifecycle. 
  • Build deep relationships with senior stakeholders (Heads of Trading, CTOs, Operations Heads), proactively managing their expectations and ensuring high satisfaction and retention.
  • Lead end-to-end client onboarding, ensuring seamless integration and platform adoption.
  1. Platform Solutioning & Technical Requirements Translation
  • Understand client workflows and business objectives deeply to design tailored platform solutions, product recommendations and commercial opportunities that solve clients' operational and execution challenges.
  • Bridge the gap between clients and internal teams e.g. sales, product and engineering to capture client needs and translate them into structured technical specifications for Elwood’s Product and Engineering teams to shape the global roadmap.
  1. Prospects & Account Growth
  • Partner closely with the APAC Sales team to participate in prospective client meetings, deliver compelling platform demonstrations, and pitch Elwood’s capabilities to institutional buyers.
  • Identify and qualify growth opportunities within your existing book of accounts and develop upsell and cross-sell opportunities 
  • Represent Elwood at industry events and in discussions with ecosystem partners and venue integrators.
  1. High-Touch Technical Support & Operations
  • Participate in the APAC support rota: provide timely, high-quality technical support to Elwood clients via live chat, email, and other channels during APAC business hours, with follow-the-sun handover to London.
  • Own, Investigate and resolve complex issues (order flow anomalies, market data feeds, execution exceptions), escalating where appropriate and ensuring end-to-end resolution.
  • Create and maintain high-quality support documentation and internal knowledge base articles.
  • Continuously improve support workflows, tools, and processes to enhance customer experience and internal efficiency.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • 2-5 years of experience in a client-facing technical role such as Technical Account Manager, Client Success Manager, Solutions Engineer, or Sales Engineer, ideally serving institutional clients.

Life at Plume

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life’s moments better. Which is why we’ve built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale.

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We’re expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. 

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can’t do it exceptionally well, we don’t do it. It’s how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it’s how we’re reinventing what’s possible every day.

Role Description:

We're looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team. In this role, you'll balance hands-on technical leadership with people management, ensuring our systems are reliable, scalable, and performant while growing a high-performing team of SREs. You'll partner closely with engineering, product, and infrastructure teams to define and uphold our reliability standards across the organization.

What You’ll Do:
  • People Leadership and Management:
    • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of site reliability engineers.
    • Foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and operational excellence within the team.
    • Conduct regular 1:1s, provide constructive feedback, and support career development for all team members.
    • Mediate conflicts and facilitate effective communication within the team and with other departments.
  • Organizational Strategy and Direction:
    • Work collaboratively with your peer managers across SRE to deliver on strategic planning, OKR attainment, and ensuring alignment with overall business objectives.
    • Establish and enforce best practices for incident response, problem management, change management, and disaster recovery.
    • Drive the adoption of SRE principles and methodologies across engineering teams.
    • Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies to continuously improve our SRE capabilities.
  • Hiring and Team Growth:
    • Lead the recruitment efforts for SRE roles, including defining job requirements, interviewing candidates, and making hiring decisions.
    • Develop and implement onboarding programs to ensure new hires are successfully integrated into the team.
    • Identify skill gaps and implement training programs to enhance the capabilities of the SRE team.
  • Enabling and Empowering the Team:
    • Provide the necessary tools, resources, and support to enable SRE teams to effectively monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize system performance.

The AML Officer - North America & Caribbean is a senior role responsible for designing, owning, and continuously strengthening Cumberland's AML/CTF and sanctions compliance programs across its U.S., Canadian, and Caribbean-domiciled entities. This position serves as the primary AML authority and point of accountability for regulatory engagement, program governance, risk assessment, and BSA/AML policy across the region.

The role oversees the full lifecycle of the AML program, from policy and procedure development through program execution, regulatory reporting, and examination management, across a portfolio of entities operating under U.S. federal and state (NYDFS), Canadian (FINTRAC), British Virgin Islands (BVIFSC), and Cayman Islands (CIMA) regulatory frameworks. Th  AML Officer works closely with the Global Head of Financial Crimes, senior leadership, legal counsel, outside advisors, and regulators to ensure the firm meets its obligations and leads with a culture of compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Program Ownership & Governance

  • AML Program Leadership: Serve as the senior AML authority for all North American and Caribbean entities; own the design and execution of the AML/CTF and sanctions compliance program for these entities.
  • Policy & Procedure Authority: Develop and maintain AML/CTF and sanctions policies and procedures across all regional entities; ensure policies reflect current regulatory requirements, enforcement trends, and the firm's evolving business activities.
  • Risk Assessment: Lead the development and annual refresh of enterprise-wide AML risk assessments; identify inherent and residual risk across customer, product, geographic, and channel dimensions; present findings and risk ratings to senior management and boards. Lead control enhancement and remediation strategy for self-identified issues.
  • Program Governance: Establish and maintain program governance frameworks including issue management, findings tracking, escalation protocols, and management reporting; ensure open items are remediated on schedule and program gaps are surfaced proactively.
  • Senior Management & Board Reporting: Prepare and deliver periodic AML program reports to senior management, boards, and governance committees across entities; provide clear, data-driven assessments of program health, risk posture, and remediation status.

Regulatory Compliance & Examination Management

  • Regulatory Relationship Management: Serve as the primary AML point of contact for regulators across the region, including FinCEN, NYDFS, FINTRAC, BVIFSC, and CIMA.
  • Examination Preparation & Response: Lead preparation for regulatory examinations and internal/external audits; coordinate document production, draft cover narratives, manage examiner meetings, and oversee remediation of examination findings.
  • Regulatory Reporting Oversight: Oversee the timely and accurate filing of required regulatory reports across jurisdictions, including SARs (FinCEN), STRs (FINTRAC), and equivalent suspicious transaction reporting obligations in BVI and Cayman; review and approve material filings.
  • Regulatory Change Management: Monitor and assess emerging AML regulatory developments across all applicable jurisdictions; evaluate impact on the firm's program and business activities; translate regulatory changes into actionable policy and procedure updates.

Jurisdictional AML Program Management

  • United States - Federal: Maintain deep expertise in U.S. federal AML obligations under the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), USA PATRIOT Act, FinCEN regulations, and OFAC sanctions requirements; oversee program components including CIP, CDD, EDD, transaction monitoring, SAR filing, and recordkeeping for U.S.-domiciled entities.
  • United States - New York (NYDFS): Manage compliance with NYDFS-specific requirements applicable to Cumberland's New York licensed entity, including NYDFS Part 504 (Transaction Monitoring and Filtering Program requirements), BitLicense obligations under 23 NYCRR 200, and annual certification obligations; serve as the NYDFS AML contact and manage examination and inquiry responses.
  • Canada (FINTRAC): Oversee AML/CTF compliance for DRW's Canadian operations under the Proceeds of Crime (Money Laundering) and Terrorist Financing Act (PCMLTFA) and FINTRAC regulations; ensure obligations are met with respect to client identification, beneficial ownership, transaction reporting, and STR filing; maintain FINTRAC registration and manage examination readiness.
  • British Virgin Islands (BVIFSC): Oversee AML/CTF and sanctions compliance for BVI-domiciled entities under the Proceeds of Criminal Conduct Act, the Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Code of Practice, and applicable BVIFSC guidance; manage BVIFSC relationship, examination responses, and STR obligations to the BVI Financial Intelligence Agency (FIA); ensure policies reflect 2025 BVIFSC inspection findings and updated AML/CTF/sanctions requirements.
  • Cayman Islands (CIMA): Maintain program compliance for Cayman-domiciled entities under the Proceeds of Crime Law (PCL), Anti-Money Laundering Regulations (AMLRs), and Guidance Notes on the Prevention and Detection of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing; ensure obligations are met with respect to customer due diligence, suspicious activity reporting to the Cayman Islands Financial Reporting Authority (CIFRA), and CIMA oversight requirements.

Investigations & Financial Intelligence

  • Escalation Authority: Serve as the final escalation point for complex or sensitive AML investigations, alert dispositions, and SAR/STR filing decisions across all regional entities; provide guidance on novel or high-risk fact patterns.
  • SAR/STR Filing Decisions: Review and approve SAR and STR filings across jurisdictions; ensure filings are complete, accurate, timely, and appropriately documented; maintain a filing log and oversee recordkeeping obligations.
  • Sanctions Program Oversight: Oversee OFAC and equivalent sanctions screening programs across entities; review and approve responses to potential matches; ensure screening coverage is appropriate for the firm's counterparty and transaction profiles.
  • Blockchain Analytics Oversight: Direct the use of blockchain analytics tools (Chainalysis, TRM Labs, or equivalent) within the AML program; ensure alert thresholds, risk scoring, and investigation protocols are calibrated appropriately and reviewed periodically.
  • Crypto Financial Crime Typologies: Maintain current, deep knowledge of financial crime typologies specific to digital asset markets; apply typology knowledge to refine the effectiveness of the program.

Program Influence & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Training Program: Develop and deliver AML training programs for compliance staff, operations, the business, and senior management; ensure training is current, jurisdiction-specific where required, and appropriately documented; track completion and maintain training records.
  • Cross-functional Engagement: Partner with legal, operations, technology, and trading to ensure AML program requirements are understood and embedded into business workflows; provide timely, well-reasoned guidance on counterparty activity, policy questions, and escalated matter.
  • Program Influence Without Direct Authority: Drive program outcomes and accountability across the AML function through influence, expertise, and collaborative engagement; build strong working relationships with AML analysts, operations teams, and business stakeholders to ensure program standards are consistently applied.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years of BSA/AML compliance experience, including at least 3-5 years in a senior AML officer, deputy officer, or equivalent leadership role at a financial institution, digital asset firm, or regulated entity.
  • Multi-jurisdictional AML Expertise: Demonstrated, hands-on knowledge of AML/CTF regulatory frameworks across at least two of the following: U.S. federal (BSA/FinCEN/OFAC), NYDFS, Canada (FINTRAC/PCMLTFA), British Virgin Islands (BVIFSC), or Cayman Islands (CIMA); willingness and ability to rapidly develop proficiency across all five jurisdictions.
  • Program Design & Ownership: Proven track record of designing, implementing, or materially improving an AML/CTF compliance program at regulated financial institutions; experience owning policies, risk assessments, and governance frameworks.
  • Regulatory Engagement: Direct experience preparing for and responding to regulatory examinations, inquiries, or audits; ability to manage examiner relationships professionally and produce high-quality regulatory responses under deadline pressure.
  • Investigations & SAR Authority: Experience serving as a SAR/STR review and approval authority; strong judgment on escalation decisions, complex alert dispositions, and novel financial crime typologies relevant to digital asset trading.
  • Digital Assets Experience: Prior experience in a virtual currency, crypto trading, or digital asset compliance environment; familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis and Elliptic and the financial crime risks unique to crypto markets.
  • Communication & Executive Presence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to present complex compliance matters clearly to boards, senior executives, and regulators; experience drafting board-level compliance reports and regulatory submissions. Ability to lead and collaborate efficiently with AML and external resources.
  • Judgment & Independence: Sound independent judgment on ambiguous regulatory questions; comfortable operating in fast-moving, high-accountability environments with limited precedent.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Regulatory Experience: Prior experience as a regulator, examiner, or compliance officer embedded in a regulatory examination process at FinCEN, NYDFS, FINTRAC, BVIFSC, CIMA, or a comparable authority.
  • NYDFS Expertise: In-depth knowledge of NYDFS Part 504 certification requirements, BitLicense obligations, and NYDFS examination procedures; prior experience managing a NYDFS examination or enforcement matter.
  • Caribbean Jurisdiction Experience: Hands-on experience operating an AML/CTF program under BVI (BVIFSC) or Cayman (CIMA) regulatory frameworks, including familiarity with local legislative requirements, reporting obligations, and examination practices.
  • Canada FINTRAC Experience: Direct experience managing a FINTRAC-registered AML compliance program, including registration maintenance and FINTRAC examination readiness.
  • Multi-entity Program Management: Experience managing AML programs simultaneously across multiple legal entities, jurisdictions, or business lines with distinct regulatory obligations and risk profiles.
  • Sanctions Expertise: Advanced knowledge of OFAC sanctions compliance, including SDN screening, secondary sanctions considerations, and voluntary self- disclosure processes; experience with equivalent sanctions regimes (UN, EU, UK, Canada) a plus.

The annual base salary range for this position is $160,000 to $215,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.

California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice.

About Bitdeer:

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for Bitcoin mining and AI cloud.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers. Apart from designing industry-leading ASIC chips and manufacturing mining rigs, the Group handles complex processes involved in computing across the value chain. This includes equipment procurement, transport logistics, datacenter design and construction, equipment management, and network and facility operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with a high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer operates globally with a diversified 3 GW energy portfolio, and deploys Bitcoin mining and HPC datacenters in the United States, Bhutan, Norway, Canada, Malaysia, and Ethiopia.

What you'll do:

  • Own the WoW stack definition and the TSV / hybrid-bond (HB) interface — partition, bond-pad pitch/array, keep-outs, and alignment budgets — co-defined with the foundry and the memory partner.
  • Drive the 3D-aware floorplan inputs: bump/TSV/HB maps, micro-bump and ballmap planning, and die-to-die interface placement, in partnership with Physical Design.
  • Define and close DFM and 3D design rules; run design-rule and process-assumption reviews.
  • Coordinate thermal and thermal-mechanical (stress / warpage) analysis, and feed mitigations back into floorplan, power delivery, and stack choices.
  • Drive 3D signoff: thermal, SI/PI across the die-to-die interface, and known-good-stack assumptions — clean before tapeout.
  • Work with DFT on the 3D test strategy (stacked-die test access, IEEE 1838 / known-good-die & known-good-stack) so the integration is testable.
  • Manage package / substrate co-design handoff to the OSAT (outsourced): stackup, escape, assembly flow, and yield/reliability considerations.
  • Track foundry and memory-partner deliverables and milestones, surface integration risks early, and keep the stack plan aligned with the schedule

Required qualifications:

  • BS/MS/PhD in EE, Materials, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years in 3DIC / advanced-packaging / process integration, with at least one product taken to tapeout and through assembly.
  • Direct, hands-on experience with TSV and hybrid bonding and a 3D stacking flow (wafer-on-wafer, chip-on-wafer, or SoIC/CoWoS-class).
  • Working knowledge of TSMC 3DFabric (SoIC / CoWoS / InFO) or an equivalent foundry 3D ecosystem, including the associated design kits and rule decks.
  • Solid grasp of thermal / thermal-mechanical behavior in stacked die and of SI/PI at the die-to-die interface.
  • Comfortable owning cross-organization interfaces - foundry, memory IP partner, and OSAT - and translating their constraints into actionable design inputs

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with DRAM-on-logic stacks, HBM-class memory integration, or high-bandwidth memory interfaces.
  • Background on AI / HPC accelerators or other high-power, high-bandwidth SoCs.
  • Familiarity with thermal/mechanical tools (e.g., Ansys) and 3D physical/signoff flows (Synopsys / Cadence).
  • Exposure to stacked-die test and yield debug.
  • Experience standing up a 3D-integration methodology on a small team - comfortable being the first/only specialist in the room.

Why this role:

  • You own a genuinely hard, defining problem on the chip - not a slice of someone else's flow.
  • Direct line to the foundry and memory partner; your decisions set the stack.
  • Early-team seniority with room to shape the 3D methodology and grow the function.

What you will experience working with us:

  • A culture that values authenticity and diversity of thoughts and backgrounds;
  • An inclusive and respectable environment with open workspaces and exciting start-up spirit;
  • Fast-growing company with the chance to network with industrial pioneers and enthusiasts;
  • Ability to contribute directly and make an impact on the future of the digital asset industry;
  • Involvement in new projects, developing processes/systems;
  • Personal accountability, autonomy, fast growth, and learning opportunities;
  • Attractive welfare benefits and developmental opportunities such as training and mentoring.

会社概要

Blockは、経済的な可能性を広げるという共通の目的のもと、多くの「ブロック」が団結した企業です。Square、Cash App、Afterpay、TIDAL、Bitkey、Protoなど、弊社の製品やサービスは、世界中の何百万人もの人々が、お金へのアクセスや管理、移動をより柔軟にコントロールできるようサポートしています。弊社は、誰もが経済活動に参加し、成功を収める機会を得られるべきだという信念のもと、商取引や金融サービスをより身近なものにするツールを構築しています。

Blockの財務オペレーションチームは、取引先銀行、カードネットワーク、決済パートナー、社内プラットフォームを通じた資金移動に関する業務を担っています。チームの使命は、顧客である加盟店さまが、決済受付、販売の完了、資金の精算、売上金の受け取りを確実かつ効率的に、規制に準拠した費用対効果の高い方法で行えるようにすることです。この使命を果たすため、Blockは、金融機関、決済ネットワーク、業界パートナー、規制要件、社内システムで構成される、厳格に規制された複雑なエコシステムの中で事業を運営しています。財務オペレーションチームは、日本におけるSquareの長期的な成長を支えるために必要なインフラストラクチャ、管理体制、パートナー社との関係、運用能力を構築する上で不可欠な役割を果たします。

日本の財務オペレーション責任者の役割は、市場におけるSquareの財務オペレーション戦略を主導することです。重要な決済パートナー社や取引先銀行との関係を統括し、業務のレジリエンスと統制を強化するほか、日本でSquareが安定して事業を拡大できるようにしていただきます。東京を拠点とするこのハイブリッドな役割には、決済に関する深い専門知識、優れた判断力、社内外の上層部のステークホルダーに働きかける能力が求められます。

職務内容

この役割では、Square株式会社の財務オペレーション戦略を測定可能な成果として具体化することが求められます。決済、製品、業務、パートナーシップ、規制当局との連携などの分野にわたって、パフォーマンスの向上、新たな機能の導入、厳格に規制された複雑な市場におけるSquareの成長をサポートしていただきます。

主な業務

  • Square株式会社の財務オペレーションにおける優先事項の実行を主導し、地域およびグローバル戦略を明確な市場計画や成果として具体化する。
  • 信頼性、決済、インシデント管理、管理体制、コスト効率、加盟店さまの体験など、入出金に関する運用パフォーマンスにおいて責任を持つ。
  • 銀行、加盟店管理会社、カードネットワーク、決済プロバイダー、業界団体、規制当局、その他の戦略的パートナー社の上層部との関係を構築・管理する。
  • Squareの成長、製品ロードマップ、リスク要件、コスト目標を支えるために、決済パートナー社や取引先銀行との商業面および業務面での交渉を主導する。
  • 財務オペレーションの専門知識が求められる、パートナー社、業界、規制当局、公の場などにおいて、Square株式会社を代表する。
  • プロダクト、エンジニアリング、リスク、コンプライアンス、法務、ポリシー、財務、マーケティング、オペレーション各チームと連携し、新たな機能を提供するとともに、日本市場固有の課題を解決する。
  • 信用照会のパフォーマンス、決済の信頼性、勘定照合、決済コスト、チャージバックの結果、取引先のパフォーマンス、運用管理体制を改善する機会を特定する。
  • 日本における規制、ネットワーク、パートナー社、業界の変化をモニタリングし、社内の各チームが足並みを揃えて対応できるよう主導する。
  • 意思決定と透明性を向上させ、責任の所在を明確にするためのガバナンス、報告体制、業務サイクル、エスカレーション経路を確立する。

応募要件

  • フィンテック、決済、銀行、カードネットワーク、加盟店契約、カード発行、決済業務、または関連する金融サービス分野での15年以上の実務経験
  • カードネットワーク、加盟店管理会社、カード発行会社、決済処理会社、銀行、規制当局、政府機関、業界団体など、日本の決済エコシステムに関する深い専門知識
  • パートナー社、金融機関、規制当局、業界団体、市場のステークホルダーの上層部との関係を構築し、働きかけてきた確かな実績
  • 複雑な契約交渉に加え、コストやリスク、コンプライアンス、顧客体験、製品がもたらす成果、成長のバランスを調整した経験を含む、ビジネス上の優れた判断力
  • パートナー社の上層部、規制当局、政府関係者、業界団体への対応や一般向けの場など、社外で会社を代表した経験
  • 不確実な状況でも周囲をリードし、複雑な課題を計画に具体化し、ビジネス、製品、オペレーション、規制、技術に関するさまざまな課題において、測定可能な成果を上げた実績
  • プロダクト、エンジニアリング、財務、法務、コンプライアンス、リスク、ポリシー、マーケティング、オペレーション各チームと連携し、複雑な部門横断的イニシアチブを主導した経験
  • 英語でのエグゼクティブレベルのコミュニケーション能力とプレゼンテーションスキル。上層のステークホルダーに対して明確かつ説得力のある提言を行う能力
  • ネイティブレベルまたはビジネスレベルの日本語能力。日本を拠点とするパートナー社や規制当局と交渉し、働きかけ、信頼関係を構築する能力を含む

望ましい経験・知識

  • 経済産業省、金融庁、または関連する決済・金融サービス分野の当局など、日本の主要な規制当局または政府機関と直接連携した経験
  • 決済ファシリテーター、加盟店契約、カード発行、決済、クリアリング、勘定照合、カードネットワークの運用モデルに関する知識
  • 米国に本社を置くフィンテック、テクノロジー、決済、または金融サービス企業での勤務経験
  • メディア対応トレーニングの受講経験、または外部スポークスパーソン、業界代表者、市場の上級責任者としての実務経験

Application Guidelines

Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.

Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws.

descriptions.job-1b2jdr7:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

Ripple is building the Internet of Value: infrastructure that moves money as fast as information moves today. Every payment that flows across our network passes through real-time financial crimes controls: sanctions screening, wallet risk analysis, transaction monitoring, and travel rule compliance. The Financial Crimes Engineering team builds and operates that layer.

This is the engineering that determines whether payments clear or hold, whether Ripple meets its regulatory obligations across jurisdictions, and whether the network can scale without compromising on compliance. The problem space is genuinely hard: high-throughput distributed systems, real-time decisioning, multi-source coordination across external compliance data providers, regulator-grade audit trails, and resilience.

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on this team, you will set the multi-year technical direction for the compliance control plane and drive its adoption beyond your own team. You will own the architecture of the vendor-agnostic, resilient, provable system that lets Ripple move value without moving financial crime, and you will shape how compliance engineering works across the company. This is a role for someone who defines which problems the organization solves, not only how they get solved: you will set the technical strategy other teams build against, establish the patterns that become organizational standards, and serve as the senior-most engineering voice on how regulatory obligations become durable infrastructure.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Own the multi-year architectural vision for the compliance control plane: real-time screening orchestration, the resilience and observability layer, vendor-agnostic integration, and the decision and data plane, sequenced against where Ripple's products and regulatory surface will be in three years, not where they are today
  • Drive the hardest, highest-ambiguity technical problems end to end: multi-vendor failover, sub-second decisioning under load, regulator-grade auditability, and resilience across partial dependency failures
  • Set technical direction that extends beyond FinCrimes: define the integration contracts, resilience patterns, and compliance primitives that partner engineering teams adopt, and drive alignment across organizational boundaries where no single team owns the outcome
  • Translate evolving regulatory obligations and organizational goals into durable engineering primitives and a sequenced technical roadmap, and influence what the organization invests in to get there
  • Anticipate platform risks and scaling constraints years before they become incidents, and lead the initiatives that address them
  • Partner directly with executive leadership across Engineering, Compliance, Legal, and Product to shape how regulatory requirements become engineering reality, and represent the platform's technical position to auditors, regulators, and external partners
  • Set standards for production ownership across the team and beyond: observability, alerting, incident response, and the reliability bar that other teams calibrate against
  • Multiply the technical capability of the organization: mentor staff and senior engineers, elevate design quality through architecture review, and raise the ceiling of what the team can take on

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

  • 12+ years building production backend systems, with deep expertise in Java (or comparable JVM languages, Go, Rust)
  • A track record of owning architecture for complex distributed systems at scale across multiple teams or organizations, defining the designs that others build against and that outlast your involvement
  • Demonstrated ability to set technical direction at the organizational level and drive adoption of standards and patterns across team boundaries without formal authority
  • Strong resilience and distributed-systems design instincts: failover, graceful degradation, idempotency, high-throughput real-time decisioning, and designing systems that survive the failure of dependencies you do not control
  • Excellent API design judgment (REST/gRPC) and a history of establishing patterns that become organizational defaults
  • Proven skill navigating ambiguity in a regulated environment, turning regulator findings, audit obligations, and partner asks into shippable, durable engineering plans, and defending those decisions to auditors and examiners
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes, observability tooling (Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar), and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)
  • A track record of developing senior and staff engineers and measurably lifting the technical bar of an organization
  • Experience in fintech, payments, identity, or compliance technology is a strong plus, though exceptional systems architects from adjacent high-stakes domains are welcome

WHY THIS ROLE

  • Consequence: your architecture decides whether real payments clear, in real time, for real customers.
  • Ownership beyond the platform: you are not owning a service or even a system, you are shaping the compliance control plane that every Ripple product depends on and the standards that partner teams build to.
  • Building the next generation: we are actively designing the vendor-agnostic, resilient compliance platform built to scale across new jurisdictions and product surfaces. This is the person who leads that design and sets its direction for the next several years.
  • Executive-level influence: you will work directly with senior leaders across Engineering, Compliance, Legal, and Product. The job is technical, but the influence is organizational.
  • Technical leadership without leaving the code: the senior-most IC voice on a team where the engineering genuinely matters.

Other common names for this role:

Actual salaries may vary based on numerous factors including, among other things, an individual applicant’s experience and qualifications for the position. This range does not include equity or additional compensation, such as bonuses or commissions. 
CA Annual Base Salary Range
$236,000—$295,000 USD

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. 
  • Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity

Take Care of Yourself

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge
  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

About Alchemy

Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. From enabling $1+ trillion in financial transactions worldwide to scaling L2s and enabling DeFi, Alchemy provides the infrastructure and tools developers need to build reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences.

Trusted by companies like JPMorgan, Stripe, Visa, Franklin Templeton, Nike, and backed by a16z, Coatue, Silver Lake, Lightspeed, and Stanford University, Alchemy is building the foundational layer for a decentralized and AI-enabled Web3 ecosystem. For more information, visit alchemy.com.

About the role

Self-serve is how Alchemy grows. The dashboard and the developer experience around it are the primary revenue engine for our flagship products: developers discover us, sign up, get to their first call, scale their usage, and upgrade largely without ever talking to a person. That funnel is one of the most direct levers on company-level revenue we have, and this role owns it.

It's also changing fast. A growing share of developers now reach Alchemy through an AI coding agent rather than a browser tab, and we expect agent-mediated usage to become the dominant way our platform is consumed. Building for that shift, our MCP server, agent skills, and AI-native onboarding, sits squarely in this role.

You'll run the dashboard as a product, own the self-serve growth engine, and set the experimentation and measurement standard for growth across the company, partnering with Node APIs, Data APIs, Wallets, Transaction Engine, Growth Marketing, and Billing, and spending meaningful time with customers.

What you'll own

  • The dashboard. Own signup, app creation, first key, first call, usage and CU visibility, upgrade paths, team management, and the observability developers need to debug their own traffic.

  • Developer experience end to end. Docs, SDKs, quickstarts, error messages, sandbox and testnet flows, and the first hour of every integration. Reduce time to first successful call, then time to first paid workload.

  • Own product-led growth end to end. Design the developer journey from docs, to first API call, to first paid workload, to scaled production spend. Instrument it, find the drop-offs, fix them.

  • Agent experience (AX). Make Alchemy the default infrastructure an AI coding agent reaches for. Own how our MCP server, agent skills, and machine readable docs perform inside Claude Code, Cursor, and whatever comes next.

  • Experimentation. Building the A/B and holdout tooling, running pricing, packaging, and onboarding tests, and creating a habit of shipping and learning weekly rather than quarterly.

  • The truth. Get into the warehouse yourself. Build the funnel, find the cohort that doesn't behave like the average, and bring back the answer nobody wanted to hear.

    What we're looking for

    • 10+ years in product, with deep time on developer platforms, APIs, or infrastructure, and direct ownership of a dashboard or console that developers use daily.

    • Proven product-led growth leadership: you've owned a self-serve funnel at scale and can show what you moved, by how much, and how you know it was you.

    • Rigorous experimentation practice. You know the difference between a lift and a fluke, you size tests before you run them, and you've built the culture as much as the tooling.

    • Genuinely analytical. Data Analysis is a normal Tuesday. You can build the model, audit the instrumentation, catch the bad join, and defend the number in front of the exec team.

    • Truth seeking. You'd rather be corrected in week one than right in a deck in week twelve. You go looking for the disconfirming data.

    • Cross functional gravity. You've driven outcomes across engineering, design, docs, marketing, sales, and finance without owning any of them.

    • Customer facing by instinct. You run your own discovery calls, sit in support channels, and can walk a CTO through an integration and a pricing model in the same meeting.

    • Technical enough to build with our own APIs, prototype with AI agents, and read the code when the answer isn't in the dashboard.

    • Crypto and web3 experience is a plus.

  • Benefits and Perks

    🏥 Medical, Dental, & Vision
    💪 Gym Reimbursement
    🖥️ Home Office Build-out Budget
    🥙 In-Office Group Meals
    🚅 Commuter Benefits
    🌴 Flexible Time Off
    🧘‍♂️ Wellbeing & Mental Health Perks
    🧠 Learning & Development Stipend
    🌎 Company Sponsored Conferences & Events
    💸 HSA and FSA Plans
    🧬 Fertility Benefits

     

    Alchemy is committed to offering competitive compensation, including base salary as well as equity. Additionally, Alchemy offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as other benefits such as 401k and unlimited flexible time off.

About Bitdeer:

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for Bitcoin mining and AI cloud.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers. Apart from designing industry-leading ASIC chips and manufacturing mining rigs, the Group handles complex processes involved in computing across the value chain. This includes equipment procurement, transport logistics, datacenter design and construction, equipment management, and network and facility operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with a high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer operates globally with a diversified 3 GW energy portfolio, and deploys Bitcoin mining and HPC datacenters in the United States, Bhutan, Norway, Canada, Malaysia, and Ethiopia.

What you will be responsible for:

  • Responsible for the full-process design, development, and optimization of the data center liquid cooling control system, including cooling circuit control logic, temperature/flow rate closed-loop control, energy-saving adjustment, adapting to high-density data center rack cooling requirements, and ensuring the stable and efficient operation of the liquid cooling system.
  • Lead the environmental and facility monitoring system (EFMS) design and implementation for the data center, covering monitoring of power distribution, air conditioning, liquid cooling, fire protection, security, and other infrastructure. Tasks include planning monitoring points, data collection, alarm logic design, enabling real-time monitoring and remote control of the data center's environment and device status.
  • Conduct control circuit design, including controllers, relay control cabinets, signal conditioning circuits, and more. Tasks include drawing electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, ensuring safety, reliability, and compatibility with automation needs during installation and maintenance.
  • Handle control component selection, aligned with high-reliability requirements for data centers. Select controllers, drives, sensors, relays, and verify the compatibility and compliance of components while balancing cost and performance.
  • Develop control programming, including logic programming and debugging for controllers as well as UI interface development to ensure visual management, parameter settings, fault diagnostics, and historical data retrieval with user-friendly and logically sound systems.
  • Utilize advanced programming languages (e.g., C, C++, Python, C#) to develop EFMS upper-level software and data exchange interfaces, enabling data analysis, statistical reporting, and visualization for intelligent adjustments and fault prediction.
  • Expertise in common communication protocols (e.g., Modbus, TCP/IP, CAN) for debugging communication between sensors, controllers, upper-level control systems, and the data center's operational platform, ensuring smooth, efficient, and compatible data transfers.
  • Conduct on-site automation system commissioning, including control cabinet wiring, control program debugging, and integrated tuning of liquid cooling and EFMS systems. Troubleshoot technical problems during the commissioning process to ensure designed specifications are met.
  • Assist overall data center construction progress by sharing technical requirements for automation system installation, supervising on-site implementation, coordinating challenges with contractors or equipment suppliers, and ensuring quality and timelines.
  • Develop operational manuals for the automated system, perform regular inspections, troubleshoot issues, optimize control logic/programming, and implement system updates to maintain a 24/7 reliable operation. Maintain technical documentation.
  • Strictly adhere to relevant data center regulations and industry standards related to automation systems. Candidates familiar with NEC, UL standards in the U.S. will be preferred.

How you will stand out:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in electrical automation, automation, measurement and control technology, or related fields.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in automation system design, development, and debugging. Priority given to candidates with experience in large-scale data center liquid cooling systems or infrastructure monitoring projects.
  • Proficient in liquid cooling system design and development for data centers, with a solid understanding of cooling principles and the ability to independently design control logic, develop programs, and conduct system debugging.
  • Expert knowledge of facility monitoring systems architecture, capable of independent planning, data collection, alarm design, and system integration.
  • Strong ability to design control circuits, including drawing electrical schematics and wiring diagrams, and proficient in CAD, EPLAN, or similar software.
  • Expertise in component selection, including controllers, drives, and sensors, ensuring high compatibility and performance aligned with project needs.
  • Experienced in control program development, including programming for upper-level control systems and UI development, capable of independent debugging and optimization.
  • Advanced knowledge of programming languages (C, C++, Python, C#, etc.) for developing upper-level software, data visualization, and management interfaces.
  • Familiarity with communication protocols (Modbus, TCP/IP, CAN) for debugging and troubleshooting issues related to compatibility and efficiency.
  • Adept at on-site equipment debugging, including system installation, fault resolution, and functional optimization.
  • Familiarity with American NEC and UL standards is highly desirable.
  • Experience in Linux-based development is a plus.
  • Background with data center liquid cooling technologies (e.g., cold plate or immersion cooling), particularly in energy-efficient solutions, is advantageous.
  • Strong project management, communication, and coordination skills to facilitate external and internal collaborations are preferred.

What you will experience working with us:

  • A culture that values authenticity and diversity of thoughts and backgrounds;
  • An inclusive and respectable environment with open workspaces and exciting start-up spirit;
  • Fast-growing company with the chance to network with industrial pioneers and enthusiasts;
  • Ability to contribute directly and make an impact on the future of the digital asset industry;
  • Involvement in new projects, developing processes/systems;
  • Personal accountability, autonomy, fast growth, and learning opportunities;
  • Attractive welfare benefits and developmental opportunities such as training and mentoring.

--------------------------------------------------------------------

Bitdeer does not discriminate against employees or applicants based on conditions such as race, colour, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, marital and/or parental status, religion, political opinion, nationality, ethnic background or social origin, social status, disability, age, indigenous status, and union.

About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

Polymarket operates a CFTC-regulated designated contract market (DCM) and derivatives clearing organization (DCO). As we scale, the legal and regulatory infrastructure supporting our FCM relationships has to keep pace with the business. This role exists to own that work directly — not manage it from a distance.

You'll sit inside a small, senior legal team and work closely with Compliance, Surveillance, and product. The mandate is clear: keep the FCM function legally sound, anticipate regulatory risk before it becomes a problem, and engage with the CFTC and NFA from a position of deep technical fluency. We need someone who knows FCM regulation cold, can move quickly, and will be consulted early and often by the business — not looped in at the end to sign off.

What You'll Do
